design_gotchas.title: 20 mOhm Minimum ESR Floor Still Blocks Bare Low-ESR MLCCs Despite Modern 'LP' Label
design_gotchas.detail: Although NCP1117LP slashes quiescent current 10x versus classic 1117s, Table 1 (p.2) and Applications (p.10) still require 20 mOhm <= ESR <= 20 Ohm on COUT (min 10 uF per Table 1 / 4.7 uF per p.10). Typical 10 uF X5R/X7R MLCCs have 2–5 mOhm ESR and can trigger loop oscillation unless paired with a 0.1–0.5 Ohm series resistor or tantalum/electrolytic capacitor.

design_gotchas.title: High 1.3 V Typ / 1.4 V Max Dropout Leaves Tight Margin on 5.0 V ±5% (4.75 V) Rails at 1 A
design_gotchas.detail: Full-load dropout at 1 A is 1.3 V typ / 1.4 V max (Table 3 p.3), requiring VIN >= 4.70 V worst-case for a 3.3 V output—leaving just 50 mV margin on a 5 V -5% (4.75 V) bus and worse than standard NCP1117 (1.07 V typ / 1.20 V max at 800 mA) or true low-dropout AP7361C (360 mV typ). Also note VIN max is 18 V (2 V lower than NCP1117's 20 V).

design_gotchas.title: Commercial 0°C to +125°C Grade Only & Pin 4 Thermal Tab Tied to VOUT (Not GND)
design_gotchas.detail: NCP1117LPST33T3G is strictly rated 0°C to +125°C (no -40°C industrial rating, p.1–2) and ties its SOT-223 thermal tab internally to Pin 2 (VOUT)—shorting if populated on a GND-tab LM2937 or AP7361C-GND layout. On minimal copper (<40 mm²), RθJA climbs above 120 °C/W (Fig. 32 p.9), limiting 5 V->3.3 V dissipation to ~0.8 W.

design_gotchas.title: Table 3 Lists 1–5 mA Minimum Load & Crowbar Diode Needed Above 50 uF COUT
design_gotchas.detail: While Page 1 claims 'No Minimum Load Requirement for Fixed Voltage Output Devices', Table 3 (p.3) lists ILmin = 1 mA typ / 5 mA max for NCP1117-XXX (fixed variants consume 550 uA internally). Also add an external VOUT-to-VIN protection diode if COUT > 50 uF and VIN can be shorted to ground (p.11).

typical_use_cases: Drop-in standby-power upgrade on existing 1117 SOT-223 boards (550 uA IQ vs 5–6 mA on AMS1117/LM1117/NCP1117)
Consumer TV, monitor, set-top box, and game-console 5 V-to-3.3 V post-regulators needing lower idle drain
Commercial (0°C–125°C) 12 V-to-3.3 V moderate-current linear rails using tantalum or electrolytic output capacitors
Energy-Star standby-compliant 1 A linear sub-rails on standard 1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN SOT-223 footprints
engineering_summary: The onsemi NCP1117LPST33T3G is a commercial-grade (0°C to +125°C), low-quiescent-current (550 uA typ vs 6 mA on standard NCP1117) 1.0 A fixed 3.3 V (±2.0%) linear regulator in SOT-223-3 (CASE 318H) with standard 1117 pinout (1=GND, 2/Tab=VOUT, 3=VIN). It serves as a pin-compatible standby-power upgrade for AMS1117/LM1117/NCP1117 footprints in indoor equipment, but engineers must verify its 20 mOhm–20 Ohm ESR stability window (not bare MLCC-safe), higher 1.3 V typ / 1.4 V max dropout at 1 A, 18 V abs max VIN ceiling, and VOUT-connected thermal tab before production.
